Platform Admin › Version & Upgrade

Version & Upgrade

Current Version

Running version 0.9.0.

This is a release build.

CLI Version Policy

What this server tells pvault command-line clients when they check their version.

Current CLI release
1.3.0 pvault older than this prints a notice at most once a day; pvault newer than this is told the server is older.
Minimum supported version
1.1.0 pvault below this prints a warning but keeps working.
Withdrawn versions
Withdrawn pvault versions
VersionReason
1.2.1Withdrawn by this server's administrator.

These exact versions refuse to run (exit code 29) before requesting any secret. PVAULT_NO_VERSION_CHECK does not bypass this.

Entries with this reason were added through CLI_WITHDRAWN_VERSIONS on this server; the others ship with the release.

The API reads this policy at startup: environment-variable changes apply after an API restart. pvault caches it for up to 1 hour, so clients may take that long to see a change.

→ CLI version policy runbook (docs/runbooks/cli-version-policy.md)

Upgrade Procedure

Project Vault supports in-place upgrades via docker compose up -d with a newer image. The migration system applies only additive schema migrations automatically on startup — no destructive changes (column drops, renames, table drops) are ever applied automatically.

If a future version requires a destructive migration, an explicit offline procedure is documented in the runbook. Always back up before upgrading.

→ Upgrade procedure (docs/runbook.md § Upgrades)
